Science Subway Takes

by Mete Yuksel

November 25, 2026
in Musings

For the last two years, I have been keeping a list of my “Subway Takes”. At the end of every year, I do a “Subway Takes Unwrapped” by analyzing these data. (Perhaps such an analysis will be posted here in the new year…) If I ever end up on Subway Takes, many takes that I have written down would not make sense to share. Some are a little spicy, some are very niche, and some are both impolite and about concepts that probably do not mean much to people who are not thinking about population genetics regularly. I thought it would be fun to give these takes a home, emphasizing that many are hyperbolic or flippant by design.

2025:

  • Selection is just drift for the lucky few.
  • Every fallacy is just a prior.
  • Every trait is function-valued.
  • Urban ecology and evolution is a fad.
  • Theory is the only ethical way to do biology.
  • I’m not alternative, I just experience negative frequency dependent selection.
  • Elliot Sober’s evil twin is Elliot Intoxicated. He thinks species selection is fake.
  • Photos are non-Markov.

2026:

  • 01:27 01/01: The Mathematical Grift must stop. The equations aren’t profound, audiences are just eager for meaning.
  • 19:27 06/01: THE WORLD IS NON-MARKOV, I DONT FORGIVE OR FORGET.
  • 17:44 09/01: Effective parameters = simulacrum.
  • 22:14 29/03: Plasticity is just free will!
  • 23:59 15/04: Jumps are real, diffusion is fake.
  • 19:04 29/04: There is no correct null.
  • 14:47 10/06: The Wright-Fisher model is great but, believe it or not, children do not choose their parents uniformly at random. Only the gullible among us believe this to be true and spend years of our lives deriving approximations to the model in particular regimes.
  • 20:15 12/06: Every trait is plastic. You can get any reaction norm you want by just picking the right environments.
  • 23:14 20/06: Recombination is more whimsical than mutation. Corollary: antagonism or more whimsical than mutualism.
  • 13:13 21/06: Only Andreas Wagner can say evovlability. No one else!
  • 02:05 14/07: Bayesianism is a lifestyle. My priors are too diffuse for that nonsense.
  • 09:41 15/09: Diploidy is when you are born into a family. Recessivity is when a Black Sheep gets a free ride.
  • 21:42 16/09: Selection abuses and uses. It chews you up and spits out and then moves on the next hot new thing.
  • 15:47 27/09: I’m not delusional, I’m a mathematical modeler.
  • 20:07 19/11: GxE is niche construction.

A couple notes: in 2026 I started recording the time of each take. I have also edited one or two of the takes to be a bit less … unmannerly. Several have been omitted. Many of the above takes and the omitted ones have spurred from conversations with others, who know who they are.
